# pollinatoR

`pollinatoR` estimates how much of a crop’s yield depends on insect
pollinators, from experiments that compare plants with and without
pollinator access: caged or bagged plants against open ones, and
hand-supplemented plants where a trial has them. Estimates come from
mixed models, with intervals, on a scale and basis you declare. The
estimand can be carried to a population of fields and on to an economic
value, with its uncertainty kept by working draw by draw. The methods
apply to any crop studied with such a design.

## Installation

\
`# install.packages("remotes")`\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/remotes/man/install_github.html)`(``"max578/pollinatoR"``)`

### Optional Bayesian engine

`pollin_fit(engine = "flexyBayes")` fits on INLA through the flexyBayes
package. Neither is on CRAN, and neither is needed for the rest of the
package.

\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/remotes/man/install_github.html)`(``"AAGI-AUS/flexyBayes"``)`\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(`\
`  ``"INLA"``,`\
`  repos ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(`[`getOption`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/options.html)`(``"repos"``)``, INLA ``=`` ``"https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"``)``,`\
`  dependencies ``=`` ``TRUE`\
`)`

## A minimal example

An analysis is declared in layers: the data, the design, the estimand.
It is then fitted, and the effect is read on the declared scale.

\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`pollinatoR`](https://github.com/max578/pollinatoR)`)`\
\
[`set.seed`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html)`(``1``)`\
`d`` ``<-`` `[`data.frame`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html)`(`\
`  trt ``=`` `[`rep`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/rep.html)`(`[`rep`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/rep.html)`(`[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``"Cage"``, ``"Open"``)``, each ``=`` ``10L``)``, ``8L``)``,`\
`  Site ``=`` `[`rep`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/rep.html)`(`[`paste0`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)`(``"s"``, `[`seq_len`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/seq.html)`(``8L``)``)``, each ``=`` ``20L``)`\
`)`\
`d``$``pods`` ``<-`` `[`rnbinom`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/NegBinomial.html)`(`[`nrow`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/nrow.html)`(``d``)``, mu ``=`` `[`exp`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Log.html)`(``3`` ``+`` ``0.3`` ``*`` ``(``d``$``trt`` ``==`` ``"Open"``)``)``, size ``=`` ``10``)`\
\
`pd`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_data`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_data.md)`(``d``, response ``=`` ``"pods"``, treatment ``=`` ``"trt"``, unit ``=`` ``"Site"``)`\
`ds`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_design`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_design.md)`(``pd``, arms ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``excluded ``=`` ``"Cage"``, open ``=`` ``"Open"``)``, layout ``=`` ``"rcbd"``)`\
`est`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_estimand`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_estimand.md)`(``ds``, family ``=`` ``"dependence"``, scale ``=`` ``"ratio"``, basis ``=`` ``"loss"``)`\
[`pollin_assumptions`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_assumptions.md)`(``est``)`\
`fit`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_fit`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_fit.md)`(``est``)`\
[`pollin_effects`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_effects.md)`(``fit``)`

`basis` has no default. A loss share (the part of present yield that
pollinators supply) and a gain (the rise over a crop without them) are
different numbers: excluded plants yielding 75% of open ones give a loss
share of 25% and a gain of 33%.

## From dependence to value

Draws of the estimand, multiplied by price and current production, give
the value of pollination with an interval. The channel has no default:
the `dependence` channel values the production lost without pollinators
and needs a loss share.

\
`dr`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_draws`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_draws.md)`(``fit``, n ``=`` ``1000L``, seed ``=`` ``1L``)`\
`mk`` ``<-`` `[`pollin_market`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_market.md)`(``quantity ``=`` ``12000``, price ``=`` ``650``, unit ``=`` ``"t"``,`\
`                    currency ``=`` ``"AUD"``, year ``=`` ``2024``, source ``=`` ``"Illustrative inputs"``)`\
[`pollin_value`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_value.md)`(``dr``, ``mk``, channel ``=`` ``"dependence"``)`

## Functions by layer

| Layer | Function | Purpose |
|----|----|----|
| Data | [`pollin_data()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_data.md) | Declare responses, treatment, units, groups, exposures and adjustment columns |
|  | [`pollin_validate()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_validate.md) | Structural checks: missing values, expected levels, identities |
| Design | [`pollin_design()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_design.md) | Map treatment levels to the excluded, open and supplemented arms; set the layout |
| Estimand | [`pollin_estimand()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_estimand.md) | Deficit or dependence, on the difference, ratio, RII or lnRR scale, with a loss or gain basis |
|  | [`pollin_assumptions()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_assumptions.md) | The assumptions the estimand rests on |
| Fit | [`pollin_fit()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_fit.md) | One model per response, on `glmmTMB` or, with `engine = "flexyBayes"`, a Bayesian fit on INLA; the treatment effect fitted per level of a column (`by`), or pooled across its levels (`pooled`) |
| Effects | [`pollin_effects()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_effects.md) | Estimates with delta, parametric bootstrap or posterior intervals, overall or per level of `by` |
|  | [`pollin_cate()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_cate.md) | The effect at each level of a column with a random treatment slope, partially pooled |
|  | [`pollin_contribution()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_contribution.md) | Dependence on the difference scale, with FDR-adjusted p-values and the treatment-slope SD |
|  | [`pollin_moderation()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_moderation.md) | Treatment-by-exposure terms, split within and between units |
| Population | [`pollin_population()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_population.md) | Strata of one column (distance bands, regions) weighted by area, passed to [`pollin_estimand()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_estimand.md) |
| Draws | [`pollin_draws()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_draws.md) | Draws of the arm means and the estimand, by joint simulation of the fixed and random effects, parametric bootstrap, or from the posterior of a flexyBayes fit |
| Value | [`pollin_market()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_market.md) | Current production and price, as values or draws, with unit, currency, price year and source |
|  | [`pollin_value()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_value.md) | Value per draw through the `dependence` or `deficit` channel, with the assumptions it rests on |
| Guards | [`pollin_guard_spurious()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_spurious.md) | Index-versus-yield slope against a permutation null |
|  | [`pollin_guard_bounded()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_bounded.md) | Refuses to average unit-level ratios unless asked |
|  | [`pollin_guard_ecological()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_ecological.md) | Warns when an exposure slope exists only between units |
|  | [`pollin_guard_posttreatment()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_posttreatment.md) | Refuses an adjustment covariate declared downstream of treatment |
|  | [`pollin_guard_doublecount()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_doublecount.md) | Adds values draw by draw and refuses overlapping attributions |
| Indices and utilities | [`pollin_index()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_index.md), [`pollin_rii()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_rii.md) | Descriptive indices with intervals, from arm means |
|  | [`pollin_compensation()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_compensation.md) | Trade-offs among yield components |
|  | [`pollin_within_between()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_within_between.md) | Between-unit and within-unit split of a variable |
|  | [`pollin_fdr()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_fdr.md) | Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment |

`pollin_spec()` was removed at version 0.2.0; the getting-started
vignette shows the equivalent calls.

1.0.0.

# Package index

## Data

Declare the unit-of-record table and check it.

- [`pollin_data()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_data.md)
  : Declare the unit-of-record table of a pollination study
- [`pollin_validate()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_validate.md)
  : Validate the structure and internal consistency of a study's data

## Design

Map treatment levels to arms and set the layout.

- [`pollin_design()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_design.md)
  : Declare the design of a pollination experiment

## Estimand

Name the contrast, the scale and the basis.

- [`pollin_estimand()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_estimand.md)
  : Declare the estimand of a pollination experiment
- [`pollin_assumptions()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_assumptions.md)
  : List the assumptions an estimand rests on

## Population

Carry the estimand from the trial to a population of strata.

- [`pollin_population()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_population.md)
  : Declare a population of strata for an estimand

## Fit

- [`pollin_fit()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_fit.md)
  : Fit the outcome models for an estimand

## Effects

Estimates and intervals on the estimand’s scale.

- [`pollin_effects()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_effects.md)
  : Estimate the effect on the estimand's scale
- [`pollin_cate()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_cate.md)
  : Estimate the effect at each level of a grouping, with partial
  pooling
- [`pollin_contribution()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_contribution.md)
  : Estimate the pollinator contribution per outcome
- [`pollin_moderation()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_moderation.md)
  : Estimate exposure moderation of the contribution

## Draws

Draws of the estimand, for quantities computed per draw.

- [`pollin_draws()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_draws.md)
  : Draw the estimand from its sampling distribution
- [`summary(`*`<pollin_draws>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/summary.pollin_draws.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<pollin_draws>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/summary.pollin_draws.md)
  : Summarise draws of the estimand

## Value

Economic value of an estimand, computed per draw.

- [`pollin_market()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_market.md)
  : Declare the market inputs a value rests on
- [`pollin_value()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_value.md)
  : Value a dependence or deficit estimand
- [`summary(`*`<pollin_value>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/summary.pollin_value.md)
  : Summarise a value
- [`pollin_guard_doublecount()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_doublecount.md)
  [`summary(`*`<pollin_value_total>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_doublecount.md)
  : Guard against adding values that count one contribution twice

## Guards

- [`pollin_guard_spurious()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_spurious.md)
  : Guard against the spurious index-versus-yield regression
- [`pollin_guard_bounded()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_bounded.md)
  : Guard against averaging bounded unit-level indices
- [`pollin_guard_ecological()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_ecological.md)
  : Guard against reading a between-unit slope as a within-unit one
- [`pollin_guard_posttreatment()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_guard_posttreatment.md)
  : Guard against adjusting for a covariate downstream of treatment

## Indices and utilities

- [`pollin_index()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_index.md)
  : A menu of uncertainty-aware dependence indices
- [`pollin_rii()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_rii.md)
  : Relative Interaction Index with a bootstrap interval
- [`pollin_compensation()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_compensation.md)
  : Summarise yield-component trade-offs (compensation)
- [`pollin_within_between()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_within_between.md)
  : Within-between (Mundlak) decomposition of a numeric variable
- [`pollin_fdr()`](https://max578.github.io/pollinatoR/reference/pollin_fdr.md)
  : Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate adjustment
